title: Trove environment reading
description: One line of environment/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a scalar reading (one metric, one value) from a public ambient feed at a place and time. Shares its core (ts/source/metric/value) with home sensor readings so the two merge at read time. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time of the observation

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

metric.description: what was measured, snake_case: temperature, humidity, pm25, pm10, ozone, no2, so2, co, aqi, pollen, kp, water_level, discharge, wave_height, noise_db, pressure, uv, … — kept consistent with the home reading contract

value.description: the measured value (unit rides in the unit field)

unit.description: unit of value: C, F, percent, ppm, ug_m3, aqi, db, ft, cfs, m, hpa, index, …

place.description: human label of where (station / city / reporting-area name)

lat.description: latitude of the observation, in degrees

lon.description: longitude of the observation, in degrees

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (typically station/site + metric + ts)

extra.description: everything source-specific (AQI category, raw concentration, flood-stage, per-pollutant subindices, …)
